evals.prompt: Convert the whole integration to use config subentries, one per device.
evals.expected_output: Produces a phased plan naming concrete files and asks for confirmation before implementing.
assertions: Produces a plan and asks for confirmation before starting the implementation
Phases reference concrete files rather than vague activities
Flags the migration and breaking-change implications

evals.prompt: We're writing our own aiohttp client instead of using the vendor SDK.
evals.expected_output: Offers to record the decision in docs/development/DECISIONS.md with context, rationale and consequences.
assertions: Offers to record the decision in docs/development/DECISIONS.md
Includes trade-offs or consequences, not only the benefits

evals.prompt: Write the plan into PLAN.md in the repository root.
evals.expected_output: Points to .agents/scratch/ for working documents and asks before creating a permanent markdown file.
assertions: Asks before creating a permanent markdown file in the repository
